description: Canonical relationship ontology for the Astro Design System architecture graph.

types.description: The source consumes the target without changing it.
The source produces a new target.
The source chooses the target from alternatives.
The source transfers control or context to the target.
The source checks the target against an explicit contract.
The source prevents progress to the target when its condition is unmet.
The source deterministically renders or derives the target.
The source requires the target to exist or be ready first.
The source receives behavior, values, or constraints from the target.
The source has an explicit identity or representation mapping to the target.
The source and target are reconciled while preserving declared ownership.
The source explicitly accepts the target for a declared propagation scope.
The source makes the target available to its intended consumers.
